contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions received this reporting period' = $36,117.41 on the p5 Summary Page (the filer's own typed summary sheet, lettered A-G)
contributions.detail: The filer substitutes his OWN typed whole-cycle ledger for the county's Schedule A. The 'Campaign Donations' table on p2 runs the entire 2022 cycle and is partitioned BY THE DOCUMENT ITSELF into report blocks with printed banner rows ('Campaign Start', 'April 4th Report', 'June 20th Report', 'Oct 31st Report'), each banner closing the block above it. The block belonging to THIS report — the rows between the 'June 20th Report' banner and the 'Oct 31st Report' banner — is 6 rows: 50.00 + 200.00 + 33,917.41 + 500.00 + 1,000.00 + 450.00 = 36,117.41 EXACTLY = Box B. No differencing of covers or of reports was done: the partition is printed on the page. The ledger's own printed grand total, 'Total contributions: $51,261.69', is the CUMULATIVE figure and equals Box C 'Contributions received since the beginning of the year' — it is NOT summed as an increment, and the earlier blocks belong to this filer's earlier reports (his April and June filings), not to this one. IN-KIND: the last row (Utah Tech Leads PAC, 450.00) has its In-Kind checkbox TICKED; monetary-only gives 35,667.41 and FAILS, monetary-plus-in-kind gives 36,117.41 and CLOSES. The ledger's first row, '4-Mar-2022 Starting Balance $180.28', is a balance annotation and not a contribution; it sits in the pre-April block and is outside this report either way (note that it also disagrees with Box A's 170.00 — the filer's own inconsistency, transcribed here and not adjudicated).

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures made this reporting period' = $36,287.41 on the p5 Summary Page, corroborated by the page's own identity F = A + B = 170.00 + 36,117.41 = 36,287.41 and G = F - D = $0.00 exactly as printed
expenditures.detail: The 'Campaign Expenses' ledger runs from p3 onto p4 with the SAME printed report banners. The block for this report — the 17 rows between the 'June 20th Report' banner (p4 band 5) and the 'Oct 31st Report' banner (p4 band 23) — sums 50.00+139.95+139.54+50.00+50.00+1.02+11,522.80+10,935.45+9,779.28+3,000.00+17.16+40.73+60.00+17.16+17.16+17.16+450.00 = 36,287.41 EXACTLY = Box D. The ledger prints only a cycle grand total ('Total expenses: $51,261.69' = Box E), no per-sheet subtotal — so, per the §L2 rule, the first sheet was never treated as a closable unit and no phantom shortfall was manufactured; the gate is the document's own period partition against Box D. IN-KIND: the last row (Utah Tech Leads PAC 450.00) has its checkbox TICKED; monetary-only gives 35,837.41 and FAILS, monetary-plus-in-kind gives 36,287.41 and CLOSES.

itemized.in_kind_convention: MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND on both sides, tested per filing. Exactly one in-kind item exists (Utah Tech Leads PAC, 31-Oct-2022, 450.00, described in the name cell as '$300 in targeted ads & $150 in services') and the filer enters it TWICE — once on the donations ledger and once on the expenses ledger, identical date and amount, checkbox ticked on both. Both stated totals include it and neither side closes without it. The In-Kind column is a real printed checkbox column on this filer's own spreadsheet, and the ticks sit INSIDE their own row's cell (not the half-row-high offset of the newer county blank) — verified by cropping the Amount and In-Kind columns TOGETHER as one block.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE IDENTITY: the cover prints the candidate as 'Rodney W Mann' while index.csv's channel label is 'Rodd Mann' and the filename is '2022_Mann_Rodd_11.1.22.pdf'; the filer's own ledger sheets head themselves 'Rod Mann'. THE PAGE FACE GOVERNS and all three spellings are recorded here without adjudication — the channel spells this filer two ways across the corpus ('Rodd' / 'Rodney'), and the divergence must stay visible. THE OFFICE BOX IS BLANK ON THE FORM: the cover's 'Office' field is empty, so nothing about the office is inferred here; index.csv carries 'County Auditor' as a channel attribution and that is not evidence from this page. Report type ticked: 'Seven days preceding the General Election'. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS WHOLLY UNANSWERED — neither 'No' nor 'Yes' is marked; that is an honest blank and is never read as 'No'. Date of Report 10-31-2022, cover foliated 'Page 1'; the digital signature block prints a GUID and a signing timestamp of 2022.10.29 18:35:21 -06'00'. DOCUMENT SHAPE: 6 pages = the county's own v. 4.20 cover (p1, born-digital fillable, Josh Daniels masthead) + the filer's OWN typed spreadsheet substituted for the county's Schedule A / Schedule B / Summary Page (p2 'Campaign Donations', p3-p4 'Campaign Expenses', p5 'Summary Page' lettered A-G) + a blank p6 (read; genuinely blank). Per §E5 the sides are therefore TRANSCRIBED, never 'no-schedule-page' — what is missing is the county's FORM, not the filer's entries. The filer's own summary is internally consistent: F = A + B = 36,287.41 as printed, G = F - D = 0.00 as printed, and it letters its close box G (that is his spreadsheet's own layout and says nothing about which county blank he used — the cover is v. 4.20, whose close box is unlettered). WHAT THIS FILING PUBLISHES: the ledger is CYCLE-scoped and the document itself partitions it with printed report banners, so only the block belonging to this report is published here (6 contributions, 17 expenditures). The earlier blocks belong to this filer's earlier 2022 reports and are transcribed under those filings — publishing them here would double-count the same donors across two filings of the same cycle. This is NOT the §A6 'cumulative-exact' case: there the schedule restated the whole cycle with no internal partition and closed only on the cumulative column, whereas here the per-period block closes EXACTLY on the promoted per-period Box B / Box D, and the cumulative figure (51,261.69, printed as 'Total contributions' and 'Total expenses' and repeated at Boxes C and E) is left as the cumulative it is. Nothing was differenced. PRIVACY: this filing is NOT named '_Redacted' and the cover publishes the candidate's own street address, phone and email in the clear — none of it is carried into this record, not in a field and not in a note. Donor rows carry city/state only because that is all the filer's 'City and State' column holds. OTHER SOURCE PROPERTIES OBSERVED, none affecting this report's arithmetic: (a) the In-Kind cell of the 31-Mar-2022 Rod Mann row prints the literal word 'FALSE' instead of a checkbox glyph — a spreadsheet export artifact, in a prior-period block; (b) the last row of the p3 expenses sheet (7-Jun-2022 Mailchimp, Email marketing, $98.46) is printed AGAIN as the first row of p4 — either a repeated row at the page break or a genuine duplicate entry; it falls in a prior-period block so it does not touch this report's Box D, but it is flagged here because it WILL matter to whoever transcribes this filer's June report; (c) the ledger's 'Starting Balance' of $180.28 disagrees with Box A's $170.00 on the same document — the filer's own inconsistency, recorded and not adjudicated.
